findings.evidence: `Reflection.lean:54` has `lemma schwarzReflection_of_im_nonneg {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 ≤ z.im) : schwarzReflection f z = f z`; Mathlib has `EqOn.mono` at `Mathlib/Data/Set/Function.lean:82`.
findings.fix: Use `fun _ hz => schwarzReflection_of_im_nonneg (f := f) ...` directly, or restrict the closed-upper result with Mathlib `EqOn.mono` instead of adding separate open/inter public lemmas.
findings.issue: `schwarzReflection_eqOn_im_nonneg`, `schwarzReflection_eqOn_im_pos`, `schwarzReflection_eqOn_inter_im_nonneg`, and `schwarzReflection_eqOn_inter_im_pos` are EqOn restatements of the existing pointwise lemma `schwarzReflection_of_im_nonneg`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib provides `ContinuousOn.congr` at `Mathlib/Topology/ContinuousOn.lean:370` and `DifferentiableOn.congr` at `Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/FDeriv/Congr.lean:201`; the new proofs at lines 96, 105, 114, 123, 132, and 141 are exactly these congr calls with `schwarzReflection_of_im_nonneg`.
findings.fix: Do not add these transfer wrappers; at call sites use `hf.congr fun _ hz => schwarzReflection_of_im_nonneg (f := f) ...` or Mathlib `ContinuousOn.congr` / `DifferentiableOn.congr` directly.
findings.issue: `ContinuousOn.schwarzReflection_im_nonneg`, `ContinuousOn.schwarzReflection_inter_im_nonneg`, and all four `DifferentiableOn.schwarzReflection_*` lemmas are just one-line applications of existing congruence APIs to `schwarzReflection_of_im_nonneg`.

summary: The PR adds only thin upper-branch wrappers around the existing pointwise Schwarz-reflection lemma and Mathlib congruence APIs. These should be removed or collapsed to direct uses of the existing lemmas rather than expanding the public API with duplicated special cases.
